summary: Develop practical portfolio risk, concentration, and stress-testing skills with Excel-based exercises. Explore the five-day course and outline.
lede: Credit portfolio management assesses lending exposures to understand portfolio quality, concentration, and expected losses. For credit risk analysts, portfolio managers, and lending leaders, the training applies segmentation, vintage analysis, and PD-LGD-EAD measures to assess performance and inform lending decisions. Participants also review concentration, test scenarios in Excel, and prepare management reports and action plans, with practical coverage of AI-assisted early-warning methods.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who monitor lending exposures, assess credit risk, and translate portfolio evidence into lending or risk decisions.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of lending operations or credit risk analysis is recommended. Basic Excel skills are useful for the portfolio calculation exercises; coding is not required.
